channel.title: BBC News - World
channel.description: The latest stories from the World section of the BBC.

item.title: M5.8 quake strikes coast of Turkiye, magnitude revised to 5.8
item.description: A M5.8 earthquake hit the coast at 12:45 local time. Officials say tsunami risk is low at depth 10 km.
item.dc:creator: BBC World

item.title: Floods recede in Pakistan as cleanup begins at 14:30
item.description: Waters have dropped 2 metres after a week of heavy rain. The 2026-11-03 monsoon was the worst on record.

item.title: Floods recede in Pakistan as cleanup begins
item.description: Coastguard & army crews on scene; one official called it the "worst flood in years".

item.title: WHO opens mobile clinic in flood zone
item.description: Health teams reach 4 villages cut off since the storm & warned of cholera risk.

item.title: Power restored to 9000 homes after storm Bertha
item.description: Engineers worked through the night; 3 substations back online by 06:00.

item.title: Diplomats meet on 2026-11-04 ceasefire plan
item.description: Talks resume at 09:00 with a draft text circulating among 12 nations.

item.title: Heatwave grips southern Europe, highs of 42C forecast
item.description: Spain & Greece issue red alerts. Fire risk "extreme" near Athens through the weekend.

item.title: Aid convoy reaches besieged town after 11-day blockade
item.description: 20 trucks carried food and medical supplies; first delivery since October.
